ValidationRule.description: Make sure ServiceNow Ticket Number field is populated when Status = "Closed: Forwarded" and "Forward to Unit" = "ServiceNow"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed: Forwarded') && ISPICKVAL( Forward_To_Unit__c , 'ServiceNow') && ISBLANK( ServiceNow_Ticket_Number__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: ServiceNow Ticket Number field is required when 'Status' = "Closed: Forwarded" and 'Forward to Unit' = "ServiceNow"
